card.name: Decimal point in section cross-references
card.fires_on: The period in a section number like 2.1 or 5.1 inside parentheses at the end of a highlights sentence. Also weakly on the word expert in a Wikipedia-style 'needs attention from an expert' notice.

modes.label: Section number period
modes.description: The decimal point after the chapter digit in a parenthetical label citation to a label section.

modes.label: Expert notice
modes.description: The word expert in a cleanup banner on a web article.
modes.example: This article needs attention from an<< expert>> in Psychology.

card.plain: It fires on the dot inside a section reference such as (5.1) that points to the full label section.
